Life expectancy data from sources like the World Health Organization and United Nations consistently show Japan as having one of the highest life expectancies globally, typically around 84-85 years. Sweden also has high life expectancy (around 83 years), but slightly lower than Japan. The U.S.A. has a lower life expectancy (around 79 years) compared to other developed countries. Saudi Arabia's life expectancy is around 75-77 years. Therefore, Japan has the longest life expectancy among these options.
